recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future changes should be handled under current parameter-specific or normative-status tickets rather than reopening the already-applied FHIR-16337/ExpansionProfile removal decision.
issue_request: FHIR-16337 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 ValueSet. It asked that $expand modifiers not silently change or obscure the content of stored/base expansions, required errors when an expansion-only ValueSet is requested with incompatible parameters, allowed additional parameters only when validated as equivalent to direct expansion, required persisted expansions to record relevant $expand parameters, and called for ExpansionProfile removal/redrafting.
initial_application: The Jira application note cites svn revision 13900, represented in git by 0cf4c0c96d333dbe2a5b7a5d158f7e59db4c4b5b. That commit changed ValueSet expansion processing notes to check stored-expansion parameters, return errors for incompatible expansion-only requests, allow safe equivalent additional filtering, and require persisted expansion parameters; it also removed ExpansionProfile alongside related FHIR-16490 work.
additional_context: ValueSet and ValueSet/$expand are active in the current build. Later issues already represented on the combined branch refined the same area: FHIR-16443 audited expansion.parameter source/name behavior, FHIR-17558 removed stale ExpansionProfile references, and FHIR-41589/FHIR-41639 refined current expansion.parameter categories. FHIR-16069 separately resolved no-change on the ValueSet operations normative-status challenge, so FHIR-16337 does not imply demoting current $expand.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml carries the existing-expansion parameter check, error path, and safe additional-parameter rule; valueset-notes.xml, structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml, and operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml carry current expansion-parameter recording guidance with the persisted-expansion SHALL. ExpansionProfile is absent from active ValueSet guidance except for a dropped-resource marker in fhir.ini.
